fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 24.8 per cent of tertiary graduates in Mauritius in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 19.2 per cent of tertiary graduates in Mauritius in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 21.8 per cent of tertiary graduates in Mauritius in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
